Four m107 rows map both ratio and loading around the severe late-tail error c6924324ddd95f249df6, while four m125 rows separate sample amount from loading-solvent volume using the new matched evidence. The m207, m117, m94 and m181 groups constrain steep or potentially steep response curves with interior ratios and matched loading contrasts. Fused ketones and oxygen-rich aromatics test whether the model's analogical transfer is chemically meaningful after the m179, m180, m6 and m8 failures. The m36 and m128 groups add graph-specific amino and thioether carbonyl environments, and m173 and m200 provide polar late-finish supervision. This combination should improve generalization across Row-distribution conditions by teaching both structure-condition interactions and the separate behavior of V1 and V2, while retaining enough local redundancy to distinguish smooth interpolation from abrupt response boundaries."}
